negative_snippets:
I was quite disappointed with the food quantity at this hotel. While the taste was decent, the portions were surprisingly small for the price being charged. It felt like more focus was given to presentation rather than actual value.

If you’re someone who expects a satisfying meal for what you pay, this place may not meet your expectations. I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and improves the portion sizes in the future.
